title: PCG bans travel to Fuga Island due to live-fire military drills

blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY- The Philippine Coast Guard barred fishermen and sea vessel operators from temporary no-sail zones off Fuga Island on November 21 and Barangay Dodan on Nov. 24 due to scheduled military live-fire exercises there. Live ammunition will be used during the Counter-Landing Live Fire Exercises, part of the Armed Forces of the Philippines Joint Exercise Dagat-Langit-Lupa (AJEX DAGIT-PA 10-26) there, the Coast Guard said in a statement. The exercises intend to strengthen the country’s coastal defense capabilities.
